title: Thanked for six months of leading TExeter
summary: Six months after TExeter began as a meeting-room discussion, the managing director and HR head wrote to thank me for the leadership and guidance that made it a company-wide community.
what_would_have_happened: Knowledge sharing stayed informal and inside project teams.
the_call: Build a volunteer community with its own brand and events, without waiting for a formal program.
what_i_did: Led the TExeter team from the first discussion through its Thursday events and newsletter.
what_changed: The letter said TExeter had captured the attention of every employee and influenced many activities across the organization.

quotes.text: TExeter started off as a meeting room discussion and in six months it has grown into the hearts and minds of the employees of Exeter Software India Pvt. Ltd.
quotes.role: Managing Director and HR Head, Exeter Software India

quotes.text: All these would not have been possible if it were not for your leadership and guidance in making TExeter what it is today, and I sincerely thank you for your contribution towards this effort
quotes.role: Managing Director and HR Head, Exeter Software India
